question.text: Category III AIFs CAN directly invest into an investee company OR through:

answer.text: Units of other Cat I or Cat II AIFs (registered with SEBI), without being labelled FoF

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 3.1, Cat III AIFs can invest via units of other Cat I/II AIFs without being labelled 'Fund of AIFs'. The Trap: Mutual fund units/ETFs/deposits are different. Cross-Exam Context: Specific circular exception from June 25, 2021. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Disclose indirect holdings clearly so investors understand 2-layer fee exposure.
